episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.plot: New York doctor Joel Fleischman arrives in Alaska expecting Anchorage and instead learns his state-sponsored service will be spent as Cicely's reluctant sole physician.

episodes.title: Brains, Know How and Native Intelligence
episodes.plot: Joel treats Ed's seriously ill medicine-man uncle while trading accusations of helplessness with Maggie, as Chris loses his radio job over an on-air reading.

episodes.title: Soapy Sanderson
episodes.plot: A hermit's death leaves Joel and Maggie joint owners of valuable land, forcing them to choose between profit, preservation and the wishes of local Native buyers.

episodes.title: Dreams, Schemes and Putting Greens
episodes.plot: Shelly's apparent pregnancy pushes Holling toward a wedding he fears, while Maurice courts Japanese investors with visions of a Cicely resort and golf course.

episodes.title: The Russian Flu
episodes.plot: Elaine's visit is wrecked when flu sweeps through Cicely, leaving Joel helpless until Marilyn produces an effective Native remedy she refuses to commercialize.

episodes.title: Sex, Lies and Ed's Tapes
episodes.plot: Shelly's old husband arrives seeking a divorce, Rick worries about Maggie's supposed boyfriend curse, and Ed finally finds a subject for his stalled screenplay.

episodes.title: A Kodiak Moment
episodes.plot: Maurice tries to mold Chris into an heir, Holling pursues the bear that once nearly killed him, and Joel's childbirth class turns unexpectedly practical.

episodes.title: Aurora Borealis: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups
episodes.plot: The northern lights intensify Cicely's dreams as Joel encounters the legendary hermit Adam and Chris discovers an uncanny connection with wandering motorcyclist Bernard.
